title: fix(app-shell,plugin-detail): the record approval lock follows an answered approvals read (objectui#12220)
body:
Fixes #12220

Clause-②: yes (widening)

A record whose `approval_status` column reads `pending` no longer opens locked when the approvals read answered and found no open request. When the read answers (any 2xx), the record page and the detail body's approval band follow the open request. The literal-column fallback now stands in only while no read has answered.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM, round 8, under the claim on the card. Implementation session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK`.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/react`** (a declared surface addition; the changeset is `minor`):
  - `resolveApprovalLock({ readAnswered, openApproval, recordStatus })` is the ONE rule both sites call. It ships with its `ApprovalLockInput` / `ApprovalLockState` types and lives in `InlineEditContext.tsx`, beside the context whose fields it defines.
  - One new OPTIONAL prop, `approvalReadAnswered`, on `InlineEditProvider`, read back on `InlineEditContextValue`. Omitted, it is `false`, which is today's behaviour: the band keeps its column fallback.
  - Nothing is removed or renamed.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`** (`patch`):
  - `useRecordApprovals` returns a new `answered`.
  - `RecordDetailView` computes `approvalPending` / `approvalLocked` through `resolveApprovalLock` and threads `approvalReadAnswered={approvals.answered}`.
  - The hook is not on the package entry, so no app-shell export moves.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-detail`** (`patch`): the `showHeader === false` band computes `isPending` / `isLocked` through the same function. For a host that never sets the flag, the result is unchanged (see the table below).
- **`packages/plugin-detail/README.md`**: one bullet documenting the new prop for host authors (the docs-driven commandment 2 of AGENTS.md).

The rule, three branches in order:

1. An open approval decides. It is pending, and it locks exactly when its node's `lockRecord` says so. The objectui#2902 behaviour is unchanged.
2. Otherwise, a read that answered means nothing is running: not pending, not locked.
3. Otherwise the column stands in: the route is absent, the read has not landed, or the first read failed. `pending` / `in_approval` then reads as pending AND locked. The objectui#2618 behaviour is unchanged.

## Readings the dispatch asked for

**H1: `available` cannot tell the cases apart.** In `useRecordApprovals`, `available` starts `true`, is set `true` on a 2xx and is set `false` only on a 404 / 501. Any other failure leaves it unchanged. An empty 200, a read still in flight and a first read that failed with a 5xx or a network error therefore all read `available: true` with no rows. The hook gains `answered`: `true` once a 2xx has landed for the current object + record. It is keyed on that pair, so opening another record reads as unanswered until that record's own read lands.

**H1 (c): transient errors, my call.**
- A 5xx or network failure on the FIRST read is not an answer, so the column fallback applies. That fails closed and is identical to today: a 5xx says nothing about whether the route exists, and the column is the conservative read when nothing has been learned.
- After a read has answered, a later transient failure keeps the last answer and its rows. The hook already kept its last state; `answered` follows it.
- Both directions are pinned in `useRecordApprovals.answered-12220.test.tsx`, cases (c).
- One consequence: while the first read is in flight the column still locks. A stale-`pending` record therefore shows the lock for one round trip and then clears. A record with a real request does not flicker: it is locked by the column, then by the request.

**H2: the band and Recall follow the lock.** With an answered read and no request, the page threads `locked: false`, `approvalPending: false` and `approvalReadAnswered: true`. The band, its Recall lever and its tally do not render, the header Edit is enabled and the save bar is unlocked. A band with nothing to recall would be the same wrong answer, so the band goes with the lock. This is pinned at both sites.

**H3: the record page does render this band.** `record:details` (plugin-detail `renderers/record-details.tsx`) builds its `DetailView` with `showHeader: schema.showHeader ?? false` and `inlineEdit` on, under the page's own `InlineEditProvider`. After an empty read the host threads `locked: false` / `approvalPending: false`, which equal the provider defaults, so the band could not tell "the host read approvals and found nothing" from "no host". That is why the one optional field exists. A host that never sets it renders as before.

**H4: where the rule lives.** `@object-ui/react` is a `dependency` of app-shell and a `peerDependency` of plugin-detail, and it already carries `InlineEditContext`, the seam both sites meet at. `@object-ui/core` is reachable from both too, but the rule defines what the context's fields mean, so it lives with them.

**H5: the declared `approvalStatusField` is not reachable here, so the card is not widened.**
- The record page reads no flow metadata.
- The approvals list row carries `lock_record`, derived from the node config, but not `approvalStatusField`. Source: objectstack `plugin-approvals` `rowFromRequest`, read on objectstack `main` `2e11d9006`.
- After this change the column is read only when no approvals read answered. On an objectstack backend the list route always answers (see H6), so the literal-column read is now reached only on a backend with no approvals route, or for the first read's round trip.

**H6: the backend half, read-only.**
- Source: objectstack `main` `2e11d9006`, `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, `registerApprovalsEndpoints`. It is called unconditionally.
- Its list handler answers `res.json({ data: [] })` when no approvals service resolves, by design. The code comment reads: "No approvals plugin loaded — return empty list rather than 501 so Console badge polls don't spam the error log".
- In the same case the single-row and decision routes answer 501.
- This matches the filer's 17.7.0 probe, and the answer is not wrong: with no approvals service there are no requests and no server lock, so an empty list is the truthful answer.
- Nothing is filed, and nothing is written to objectstack.

## The band for a host that never sets the flag

For each pair a host can thread, the old OR-chain and the rule with `readAnswered: false` give the same result:

| host `locked` | host `approvalPending` | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| false | true | pending, editable | pending, editable |
| true | any | pending, locked | pending, locked |
| false | false | the column decides both | the column decides both |

The existing `DetailView.approvalBand` / `DetailView.approvalRecallGate` suites, which never set the flag, pass unchanged.

## Tests (head `c45a761`)

- **New pins.** Each site has the three triage pins plus the `lockRecord: false` control:
  - `packages/react/src/context/__tests__/resolveApprovalLock-12220.test.ts`: the rule.
  - `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useRecordApprovals.answered-12220.test.tsx`: H1 (a) / (b) / (c), in flight, and a record switch.
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.approvalLock-12220.test.tsx`: what the page threads. It covers the empty 200, an open request, 404 and 501, and the control.
  - `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailView.approvalReadAnswered-12220.test.tsx`: the band. The absence of band and Recall is paired with a same-record control that renders both.
- **Fixture triage**, two existing suites whose empty-200 fixtures stood for "no approvals API", which is now an answered read:
  - `RecordDetailView.approvalRecallGate.test.tsx`: its "no request to consult" case now answers the list route 404, which is the backend its own comment describes.
  - `RecordDetailView.userActionPredicates.test.tsx`: its `approvalLocked composition` block answers the approvals route 404, so the column stays its lock source. It also gains one case: on a `pending` record the header Edit becomes enabled once the read answers an empty 200.
- **Targeted vitest** over every test file naming the lock signals, the hook, the provider or the rule (38 files): `Test Files 38 passed (38)`, `Tests 465 passed | 6 skipped (471)`. The 6 skips are a pre-existing `describe.runIf` in another card's timezone suite.
- **`type-check`** for `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: each `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` is green, and each test project's file list includes the new pins.
- **Build closure** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --filter='@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' --concurrency=2`: `28 successful, 28 total`.

## Reverse verification

Each ablation was made with objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor hit 1 time and then 0, and the blob changed. Each restore was proven: blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The tests resolve `@object-ui/react` to source through the vitest alias, so no `dist/` leg applies.

| ablation | result | went red | stayed green |
|---|---|---|---|
| delete the rule's answered branch in `resolveApprovalLock` | red, 4 of 49 | the "answered empty" pin at each site: the rule, the page probe, the header Edit and the band | open request, route absent, controls and hook |
| drop `approvalReadAnswered={approvals.answered}` from the page | red, 3 of 27 | the page pins that wait on the threaded flag | the header-Edit case, as expected, since it reads the host's own lock |
| drop the hook's `setAnsweredFor(key)` | red, 10 of 35 | every hook `answered` case, the page pins and the header-Edit case | the rest |

## Gates (head `c45a761`, each exit read before any pipe)

- Exit 0:
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`
  - `check:test-path-roots`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:shell-escape-residue`
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: "10 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"
  - `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals`: "No test source names a pending changeset"
  - `check:new-line-citations`: "0 new citation(s)"
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the 12 changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- `check:readme-exports`: NOT MEASURED repo-wide. The precondition was not met, because 8 packages were unbuilt in this worktree, none of them changed here. Its census reads 0 fabricated and 0 wrong-path, and none of its findings name `plugin-detail`. The README bullet adds prose and no import.
- ESLint on the 10 changed TS files (`--no-inline-config`): 0 errors. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Overlap

objectui#12194 (another seat) edits `RecordDetailView.tsx` at the `ManagedByBadge` render site. This PR's second hunk in that file is the one-line `approvalReadAnswered` prop on `InlineEditProvider`, about fifty lines further down. The hunks do not overlap.

## Acceptance notes

- Delivery reaches hosted environments only with cloud's framework move, per the triage. Repairing the existing `pending` rows stays with objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2067's seat.
- Two existing test files and the README sit outside the claim's listed surface. Both test edits are fixture triage that this change forces, and the README edit follows the docs-driven commandment 2 of AGENTS.md.
